description: qmd 2.8.3 had node_modules hashes only for x86_64-linux and aarch64-darwin, and meta.platforms was narrowed to match, so llm-toolchain (which intersects component platforms) was unavailable on aarch64-linux. Add the hash and derive meta.platforms from the nodeModules keys.
title: qmd: add aarch64-linux node_modules hash so llm-toolchain builds there
